desc:
Welcome to FREDDY🐻
LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ for a FREE toy gun in-game 🔫

HALLOWEEN IS THERE 🎃
THEY BECOME STRONGER 🤖

You finally got a job! A pizzeria on the end of town, with decent pay but you'll have to work the night shift. What secrets it might be hiding?

There is 2 endings in this game for now, try to get them all!
🤝 This game is multiplayer and can be played by up to 5 players at once! Recommended to play with your friends!
🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends or to complete the game easier! 🎁
